Label: com.ravynos.firefoxtest
ProgramArguments: echo '[fftest] start'; mkdir -p /var/tmp/ff/profile; cd /var/tmp/ff; : > /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.startup.page", 0);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox -CreateProfile 'ravyntest /var/tmp/ff/profile' 2>&1; echo '[fftest] create rc='$?; /usr/local/compat/runas -t 60 0 0 /bin/sh -c 'export RAVYN_DYLD_IMAGES=1; exec /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox -profile /var/tmp/ff/profile -no-remote about:blank' 2>&1 & ffpid=$!; echo '[fftest] ff pid='$ffpid; sleep 20; ps -ax -o pid,stat,comm; wait $ffpid; echo '[fftest] launch rc='$?
